description: Digital orthophotography in year-specific S3 prefixes, including legacy collections. Native horizontal CRS and grid size are product-specific. The verified 2023 Mount Vernon source tile is 2,500 ft square with 0.5 ft pixels in EPSG:2968.

downloadedVsReferenced.imageryTiles: Catalog references full tiles. A bounded 2023 Mount Vernon GeoTIFF derivative and source metadata are archived in data-sources/downloads/posey-18129/igio/.

limitations: Reference imagery only. It provides no vertical datum or elevation measurement.
Posey County was included in the 2023 western-tier program. The archived Mount Vernon sample verifies local coverage only.
Bucket prefixes identify catalog years. They do not establish coverage by individual county or a QA acceptance date.
The 2025 leaf-on collection uses a separate catalog and acquisition record.
sourceName: Indiana Statewide Digital Aerial Imagery Catalog
